note: Playwright WebKit was NOT installed here (download host blocked), so these ran in Chromium (V8/Blink) with iPhone viewports and touch. Engine-specific numbers (canvas memory, IndexedDB, eviction, persist) must be re-measured on a real iPhone 13.

S1.question: Chunk memory and band switches at zoom 0.3-2.0
S1.method: scripted pan through near/mid/far bands with the 12.4 LRU sizes (36/27/48) and width=height=0 eviction

decision.rule: keep the 12.4 sizes; if the iPhone 13 canvas-memory ceiling is under 160 MB, near LRU 30 and sprite cache 40 MB (12.5)

confirmOnDevice: iOS canvas-memory ceiling (blank chunk = getContext null) over a 5-minute pan
no tab reload during band switches

S2.question: The look of darkness and light in tunnels
S2.method: tunnel map with sconces, sim flood-fill light blocked by rock, wall pixels lit from their own side; 3 texture variants

decision.rule: default 2 px per tile with smoothing (bilinear over half a tile); no leak through a 1-tile wall in any variant

confirmOnDevice: owner picks the look on the phone at zoom 0.75

S3.question: Save time and size
S3.method: synthetic day-200 state (30 colonists, 4,000 stacks, 1,500 buildings, mined map, live raid with 3 flow fields): snapshot + CompressionStream deflate-raw + IndexedDB put

decision.quickSave: RLE + base64 into ec2.quick on pagehide
decision.rule: targets: main thread < 8 ms, blob < 100 KB, put < 50 ms. If missed on the device: positional item rows (fields.js) and per-layer deltas before Stage 1b

confirmOnDevice: snapshot main-thread ms on the A15 (desktop numbers are 2-4x faster)
IndexedDB put ms in Safari and in the Home Screen app

S4.question: Storage eviction and containers
S4.method: write a slot; start a big save then close the page mid-transaction (swipe-kill); reopen and promote the quick-save; delete IndexedDB and reopen

decision.quickSavePath: kept (in emulation the async save finished before the page closed, so a true mid-transaction kill was not reproduced)
decision.missingColony: detected: index present, blob gone -> offer Import

confirmOnDevice: real swipe-kill in Safari and in the Home Screen app
navigator.storage.persist() answer in Safari and standalone
separate container for the Home Screen app (Move colony to the app)

S5.question: Real viewport heights
S5.method: visualViewport, inner size, dvh/svh/lvh and safe-area insets at each gate viewport (emulation echoes the configured size)

decision.layout: keep the 10.1 budgets for 664 pt (Safari) and 763 pt (app); landscape 335 pt

confirmOnDevice: visualViewport in Safari portrait and landscape with the toolbar shown and collapsed

S6.question: Touch
S6.method: synthetic taps with seeded Gaussian finger error at the centres of 44 pt cells (4 pt gaps), 20 pt pips with 44 pt hit areas, and a 16 pt colonist over a 64 pt bench (colonist-first within 22 pt)
confirmOnDevice: real thumbs: 9 of 10 taps on the intended target
